notes:
Summary: QuillBridge builds an AI-assisted routing and tagging layer that sits on top of Zendesk / Freshdesk for mid-market SaaS customers. They want a summarization + auto-tagging engine to reduce TTR and enable macros to auto-enrich tickets.

Discovery highlights:
- Heavy email + ticket volume: 8k–12k incoming messages/day; predictable peaks at EMEA morning and US afternoon.
- Current approach: rules + keyword tagging -> ~48% accuracy, lots of manual reclassification.
- Primary KPI: time-to-first-action and correct tag on first pass (goal: 75% auto-tag accuracy).
- Latency requirement: <300ms tail for agent-assist snippet, <2s for batch summary generation.
- Cost sensitivity: wants cost-per-ticket under $0.02 for high-volume tagging.
- Integration targets: Zendesk triggers/macros + Freshdesk workflows; export to Snowflake for analytics.

Customer quotes / shorthand: "We need clean summaries that our agents can read in one glance — no fluff." — Head of CX.

POC ask: 2-week sandbox using 5k historical tickets for training / prompt tuning. Produce: (1) single-sentence summary, (2) 3 suggested tags (confidence score), (3) one recommended macro action (e.g., escalate, billing_flow).

Risk notes: worried about burst behavior during product incidents — wants guaranteed fallback path (lightweight rule engine) and model-variant routing to cheaper quantized models under heavy load. Prefers Dedicated for predictable throughput but open to Hosted with Reserved capacity if SLA acceptable.

evaluation_summary:
POC results promising — single-sentence summaries concise, autosuggest tags good but need label normalization. Agent-feedback loop required. SE recommends: (1) prefix caching for common templates, (2) KV-cache warmers for peak windows, (3) a canary model-variant with quantized fallback. Cost modeling suggests Dedicated peak pool + Optimize recommendations will meet cost target if batching set to 8–12 tokens avg.

Operational notes: Need orchestration for Zendesk macros: Redwood routing -> tag suggestions -> Zendesk trigger to apply macro. Provide sample webhook and sample macro config in Drive doc.
